Prefer uppercase Issue-prefix identifiers in tracker and MCP

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-23
  description: |-
    Use the shared Issue-reference resolver at tracker get and search boundaries so mixed-case prefix and workspace-key forms resolve to one Issue. Project preferred {ISSUE_PREFIX}-{number} on new create, mutation, detail, list, and search results without rewriting stored identifiers. MCP get accepts those forms, treats malformed syntax as invalid arguments, and maps workspace mismatch as not found.
